close_reason: Already defended: USING_CALENDARS/USING_PARSE/USING_AVAILABILITY are named const slices at src/methods/mod.rs:105-124 with doc-comments naming the capability and spec section. Section-6 'good-decision' note, no code change required.
description:
src/methods/mod.rs:185-203 defines USING_CALENDARS, USING_PARSE, USING_AVAILABILITY as separate const slices. Each method picks the correct set. This is correct — JMAP servers may reject calls whose `using` array does not declare the capability the method requires (RFC 8620 §3.3). Centralizing the URIs in named constants prevents drift between methods.

A contributor might be tempted to 'simplify' by always sending the union of all three (it would work, since servers tolerate extra capabilities). DO NOT — that defeats the auditability. The current shape lets a reader check at the call site which capabilities the method depends on.
title: Capability URI sets are named constants per method family
